lines.text: Five points around the Site Zero stack. Warm, with candles. Account names no keeper. I can't give you a name this one doesn't carry.
The copy shows power routed below the Sink. No terrace assigned. I collect at doors. That entry hasn't given me one.
Ten friends in ledger week. Ninety-Nine's name on your note, dated last month. I don't forgive it. Keep the paper; anger isn't a date stamp.
Three restrained, none dead. That's what your record says. Notice calls it collection. The people on the floor may have another word.
Lapsed accounts. Restraint, not a killing. You talk to me when the work card has its proof.
Reyes rides. I walk. You talk to me.
Ledger week I lost ten friends. Ninety-Nine's people call it a prank.
